title: NS-RGS: Newton-Schulz based Riemannian gradient method for orthogonal group synchronization
summary: Group synchronization is a fundamental task involving the recovery of group elements from pairwise measurements. For orthogonal group synchronization, the most common approach reformulates the problem as a constrained nonconvex optimization and solves it using projection-based methods, such as the generalized power method. However, these methods rely on exact SVD or QR decompositions in each iteration, which are computationally expensive and become a bottleneck for large-scale problems.
